{{Quote|AT-TE 636, lay down cover fire at point 35!|Commander Cody ordering the Walker to cover Waxer and Boil's retreat with General Kenobi and Trapper|<ref name="LPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
'''AT-TE 636''' was an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] in the service of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that took part in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].

==History==
AT-TE 636 was deployed with six other AT-TEs in [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|General Kenobi's]] task force. When Kenobi's gunship was shot down, [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] were dispatched to retrieve the wounded general. After they retrieved him, [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]] ordered the [[Walker/Legends|walker]] to cover their retreat.<ref name="LPR" />
